RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Resuming (16-weeks). Right amongst it in top company. Reliable first-up performer while brought on by 2 trials. McDonald rides and drawn to perfection. Hard to beat.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: MyRacehorse No 1, Fairway Thoroughbreds Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (22-weeks). Won twice in black type company last prep and warmed up with two solid trials here. 1200m is the query but handles wet ground and right in this.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Let-up (70-days). Raced in back half and was never in a position to mount a serious challenge at Eagle Farm. Genuine 1200m horse who has trialled well and Grp 1 placed. Must respect.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: S G Darby, D Foote Et Al
Spotlight: Hauled them in effortlessly at Rosehill at $3.20. Relishes the sting out of the ground. Ticks the track and distance win box. In outstanding form and stays under strong notice for this.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: M J Zammit, M Zammit Et Al
Spotlight: Compounded after leading in heavy ground at Rosehill. Adverse barrier tests. Could get into the placings.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mrs T Rook, Slice Syndicate Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (40-weeks). Placed in elite company last time. Had several trials since his last run. Hasn't won at 1200m and best viewed as a rough place hope fresh in this line-up.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: A E Koundouris & Mrs G Koundouris
Spotlight: Resuming (17-weeks). Smart mare who was consistently around the mark last prep. Excellent first up record while cruising through a winning trial at Randwick. Gets the gun run. Major player.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Ordinary performance in small field in sloppy conditions at Rosehill for new trainer. First time around Randwick and others with more to offer at this level.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: B H Perks, Ms A M Clough Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (21-weeks). Tends to race well first-up without winning. Prefers better than heavy. Best viewed as a rough place hope fresh in this line-up.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: HK Import returning for second Australian campaign (56-weeks). Proven fresh performer. Has early speed. Keep safe.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: D L Hewitt & Ms J C Preston
Spotlight: Pure speed merchant. Great effort in the Sir John Monash Stakes Caulfield two back. Brave after showing speed this venue. Sticky gate but has early pace. Must consider.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: B J Bowman, G R Nilsson Et Al
Spotlight: Resuming after a (69-weeks) spell. Seasoned galloper best over longer these days. A the bottom of his win range here. Tough ask fresh off the long lay-off.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: R Jolly, J Bechara Et Al
Spotlight: Caulfield (Bm84) placegetter 27 Jun. Not disgraced on a soft deck at Flemington over this journey at $12. Wet tracks certainly don't pose a problem. Worth a look.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: A Bain, Seymour Bloodstock Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (37-weeks). Latest trial work was solid. One for multiples fresh in this affair.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: G G Tully, T K Thompson Et Al
Spotlight: Great effort in the Santa Ana Lane Sprint Final Flemington two back. Just got there in the 4yo+ Hcp this track in rain affected going. Relishes the sting out of the ground. Fit from racing and right in the mix again.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Resuming (13-weeks). Right amongst it in top company. Not beaten far Benchmark 72 company first-up last preparation. Finds a harder setup.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Kept fresh. Ridden back, battled home without threatening at Flemington. One for your exotics.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Ms J Heaney, R M Warnock Et Al
Spotlight: Freshened. Really good run in testing conditions coming from the back in (Bm76) at Morphettville Parks over longer assignment. Drops to shorter trip. Could get into the placings.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: T J Doudle, S D Bland Et Al
Spotlight: Now 4 weeks between runs. Just missed at Rosehill 27 Jun. Prominent, showed plenty of ticker in heavy ground to just go under at Randwick. Respecting.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Clarken Bloodstock, M K Jennings Et Al
Spotlight: Not far off them in the small field this track. Has form in wet. All the better and not out of this.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fair performance without threatening on a soft deck at Sandown-Hillside at $5.50. Dual winner this trip. Capable of making an impact.

Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Capable sort at his best as he showed when landing a 1m2f Listed race on heavy last summer at Compiegne (where he has a good record) before a respectable run in the Group 3 Prix du Prince d'Orange; didn't start this campaign strongly but did better last time and could find improvement for a first try over this distance (dam stayed this sort of trip).

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unraced as a 2yo and went on quite the winning streak last year when a tongue-tie was applied, progressing from an opening mark of 81 to 100 when he was second in the Group 3 Cumberland Lodge Stakes (1m4f, soft) by October; bagged a career best on his seasonal return but didn't need to repeat that when beating popular stablemate Hamish two months ago; seems to handle most ground, so leading claims.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Paolo Zambelli, Carlo Pellegatti Et Al
Spotlight: Notably went off favourite for last year's Melbourne Cup, albeit he finished down the field, following a solid season, and has been steadily improving in 2026, most recently landing a 1m4f good-ground Listed race at Lyon Parilly a month and a half ago under this rider by 4l; beaten a nose by Parachutiste on the same terms prior to that, so hard to dismiss.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Qatar Racing Ltd, Ecurie Skymarc Farm & Ecurie Des Monceaux
Spotlight: Won a 1m4f good-ground Listed contest at Clairefontaine last year in a solid season and has run three smart races following a gelding operation in 2026, beating Presage Nocturne two runs ago (1m4f, good) before narrowly denied by Sons And Lovers upped to 1m6f; seems adaptable with regard to trip and should place a part.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: No wins since his debut but produced plenty of decent efforts in Group company and he comes into this having recorded a career best behind Goliath in a 1m4f Group 2 on good ground when last seen in late May; player if the 69-day absence hasn't left him a little rusty; seems choice of the owner's retained rider.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unbeaten son of Frankel, who only made his debut at the beginning of May; improvement with every start, the last two over 1m4f on good ground, the most recent being a Listed event; almost certainly capable of better on this next step up the ladder, and needs to on the figures, but the owner's retained rider Maxime Guyon is booked to ride Oracle.

Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
OwnerName: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a win in a handicap in Bahrain (5f, good); he has raised his game on turf this summer, winning a Listed race at Cork (5f, good; cheekpieces first time) in June; the cheekpieces were absent when he was a fine third in a Cork handicap two weeks ago, doing best of the far-side group, and another big run seems likely.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Progressive last year and he has continued the good work in 2026, winning 6f handicaps at Kempton and Newcastle either side of lesser turf efforts, albeit in hot handicaps; has run well at Ascot in the past and although he has yet to race over 5f, he is a strong traveller who could prove suited to it; interesting.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Began the season with two dominant 5f wins on AW; well short of his best on last two starts (6f, good and AW); returning to 5f won't hurt and the return of cheekpieces could perk him up; can't discount.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Ran on well when third in a C&D handicap last month; not in the same form when down the field in the Stewards' Cup last week; not discounted in these slightly calmer waters.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
OwnerName: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXI And Partner
Spotlight: Had a fine year in 2025, winning four times including in Listed and Group 3 company; not in comparable form so far in 2026 but the handicapper is easing his burden.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Made good progress last season and he has improved again this year, finishing third of 17 over C&D on his reappearance and winning at Ffos Las (5f, good) and C&D (good to firm) on his last two starts; up another 5lb but foolish to think he has reached his ceiling.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Looked good when making a successful British debut for Marco Botti at Southwell (5f) in March; no progress since and he was sold for 40,000gns last month; best watched on stable debut despite being back to his winning mark.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Three front-running AW wins in the spring saw him soar up the handicap; he didn't run badly off his revised mark at Epsom on Derby day and last week's Stewards' Cup was always going to be a tough assignment; this is more suitable but others look better treated.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: His three good runs this year have all come at Ascot, winning in May (6f, good) and doing best of those in the stands' side group when sixth behind All Ways Glamorous here two weeks ago (cheekpieces on for the first time; first 5f run since 2024); can get it wrong at the start but he has races in him off this mark.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Fine strike-rate; hit hard for her runaway win at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) in May and she has finished down the field in two runs since; others look more persuasive.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: Improved efforts of late, brushing aside two rivals at Yarmouth (11.4f, good to firm) last Sunday; should make another bold bid under a 6lb penalty.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: Won 7f Thirsk maiden last July but her form has plateaued in handicaps; last of four at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) on latest outing; dropped 4lb since but will still need a personal best.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: Steady improvement first four starts, winning Lingfield maiden (1m2f, soft) in June; didn't give his running when last of eight on handicap debut at Chester six weeks ago, but he's in good hands and may well bounce back.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 but last month's close second at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) was a fine try; nudged up only 1lb; has a sound chance of going one better.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7; some improvement when third at Ripon (1m2f, good to firm; 100-1) 12 days ago, but she's up against it here from 4lb out of the weights; usual hood left off today.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
OwnerName: C Wright Mrs C Corbett G Hargreave
Spotlight: Twice-raced daughter of Cracksman; makes a suitable next step having registered a 2l success, without needing maximum pressure, in C&D maiden (good to firm) last time; interesting contender with further progress plausible.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Nicely bred filly, by Dubawi and the first foal of a dual Group 3 winner; justified favouritism, fairly comfortably, in C&D contest (good to firm) last month and looks a useful prospect; represents last year's winning yard; respected.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Creditable sixth in Group 3 kept to 6f at Ascot last time, backing up the form of her third in the Windsor Castle; record is 0-4 but she's one of the main form contenders and shapes as if this return to 7f is well worth exploring.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Well-bred filly, by Frankel out of a Group 1 winner; made all for ready success at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) last time, building on her AW effort; brings potential and adds interest.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Night Of Thunder filly who has shown significant promise over 6f, winning at Newbury then close fourth in Ascot Group 3, both on good to firm ground; looks likely to stay 7f; leading form contender and open to further improvement.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
Spotlight: First foal of an ordinary 7f/1m winner (RPR 69) for her connections; already better than her mother, having recorded an RPR of 74 when justifying favouritism in the latest of two starts over 6f at Newbury; needs to improve further.

RaceName: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Belied her 100-1 odds with third-place finish, beaten almost 4l, in the C&D event won by Graceful Song; needs to prove she can back up that promise and this is a much stiffer assignment.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made the frame on five of her seven starts but was well held when fourth of nine in Class 6 handicap at Newcastle (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) last week and another minor role may be her best hope here.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to 5f winner Modular Magic (RPR 86); dam 5f 2yo winner (72), half-sister to prolific 6f-1m winner Al's Memory and Graded-placed 5f 2yo winner Cloneylass; one of two newcomers from the Barron stable; riding arrangements suggest he may by the second string.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: In the frame all three starts, albeit no match for clear winner when second of four at Salisbury (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; vulnerable to anything useful but a leading contender if coping with this drop in trip.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Disappointing favourite when well-held third of six at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago but his debut second at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) a fortnight earlier was quite promising, and he still has plenty of scope to build on that.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a Listed 6f winner but was unable to land a significant blow when 80-1 for debut over C&D (good to firm) ten days ago.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya
Spotlight: Well beaten in two low-grade 7f handicaps for new stable this summer and now 0-8; can't be recommended on these terms.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (RPR 83), closely related to prolific 7f-10.6f winner Reckless Lad; one of two newcomers from the stable; market support will bring her into the equation.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No match for useful rival when second of three in tactical race at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) in June, her second start, and remains tricky to weigh up but she represents a top stable and there's a good chance she'll play a significant role.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Never involved when defending his crown in the Northumberland Plate but two of his three previous runs this season had been creditable; only 1lb higher than for his last win at Chester (September) and he was a close fourth in this two years ago; would have been tempting but for concerns about him these days on fast ground (only fifth last year on good to firm).

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Useful 1m4f performer and pretty good on his day over hurdles; however, hasn't found his best form this season at 2m/2m4f and has yet to convince as a stayer in this discipline; tried a visor last time at Royal Ascot and cheekpieces return.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Hurdle/Flat winner; ran in snatches when a 5l fifth in a 2m fast-ground handicap at the Curragh on what proved to be his final start for Donnacha O'Brien; that last run was his first on ground quicker than good and he does like the mud.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Third in a 1m4f handicap at this meeting two years ago and his run over the same trip here 15 days ago was a step back in the right direction; has some appealing form to his name at 2m, so very much in the mix.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won the 17-runner Chester Plate (2m2f, good) in May on return to turf and went in again last time at Newbury (2m, good to firm), where it was hard work in the end but he travelled strongly deep into the race; only 3lb higher and hasn't had a lot of racing.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: A winner off this mark on the AW just over two years ago when trained by David Simcock; returned from a long absence in the spring and back to his best best when coming from a long way off the pace to win well at Thirsk (2m, good) 69 days ago; back from a break with his yard going well; considered off 4lb higher.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2-11 for the Gosdens, scoring for the first time on turf when leading late on at Sandown a month ago (1m6f, good; in regular cheekpieces); later bought for 77,000gns; tackles a new trip here and might well have more to offer; good to firm seems fine.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Only eighth of ten in a 1m6f handicap at Newmarket a month ago in which he was second in 2024 and won in 2025 (on good to firm); that was yet another below-par effort and hopes rest on the tongue-tie making a difference.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: The initial positive reaction to a visor soon wore thin and he beat only one home at Newmarket last time (1m6f) with no headgear (as today); has dropped to a dangerous mark but with some major questions to answer.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: A lightly raced gelding who won over 1m4f and 2m when trained in France; only his third run for Ian Williams when fourth of 20 in the consolation race for the Northumberland Plate; whether he'll build on that now encountering fast ground for the first time is questionable, especially as he was withdrawn on account of such conditions earlier in the year.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: O B P Carroll & Anthony Vaughan
Spotlight: Won a Leopardstown maiden on the Flat on debut for this yard in May 2025 but lost way since and now switches to hurdles; not bred for this game; tongue tie goes on; watch.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner rated 62 in that sphere; made a modest start over hurdles when beaten 22l at Sligo last month; will need to improve plenty on that to feature here.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in bumpers at Listowel on her penultimate start; reportedly made a noise in running when below best in a bumper at Roscommon on latest; capable of better and should take to this discipline on breeding; player.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Sent off at 11-2 for an academy hurdle at Navan in December but tailed off having been hampered; surely capable of better than that and worth a market check on return from a 245 day break.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: David Spratt & Kevin McMunigal & Mark Hopkins
Spotlight: Not a bad run on debut in a Limerick maiden hurdle but bitterly disappointing twice since; completely tailed off in a Cork bumper latest; new cheekpieces need to spark.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: E Dillon & B Power & J J Whelan & K R Waplington
Spotlight: The most experienced filly in the field; not beaten far when third of 16 off 97 in a Cork handicap hurdle last time out; should run her race but probably vulnerable back in a maiden.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Purchased for E100,000 after comfortably winning mares' maiden point-to-point at Ballindenisk; failed to run to market expectations when tailed off in a Bellewstown bumper last month; surely better than that and too soon to write off.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; 0-4 over hurdles and rated 89; well beaten on Flat on last two starts; new tongue tie needs to have dramatic effect.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Walk In The Park filly; half-sister to winners Skyace (useful 2m-3m hurdle) and Still Ciel (1m7f hurdle); unraced dam out of bumper-winning half-sister to 3m1f chase winner Skeheenarinky; nicely bred but overlooked by Darragh O'Keefe.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-9 on the Flat and rated just 54; not bred to make a jumper and is probably best watched on hurdling debut.

RaceName: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Poet's Word filly; dam French 1m4f/1m5f AW winner, half-sister to 1m6f Group 3 winner Trip To Rhodos and 1m2f Listed winner Danza Cavallo, out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; tongue tied for debut; watch.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Successful five times from ten attempts, including in Group 3 at Newbury (1m4f, good) in April, but soundly beaten twice since; now on a retrieval mission and has to concede weight all round.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Rapidly developed into a smart performer last year, winning Listed Glasgow Stakes at Hamilton (1m3f, good); raced too freely when only ninth in Wolferton at Royal Ascot (joint-favourite) on reappearance; still has untapped potential and the last run may have blown away the cobwebs.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Superbly bred gelding whose form has hit new heights this season; runaway winner of handicap at Epsom (1m2f, good to soft) on Oaks day and followed up cosily in Listed race at Sandown (1m2f, good) five weeks ago; thriving and looks the one to beat.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Showed he can go well fresh when winning 1m2f Listed event at Epsom last spring; mostly creditable efforts in defeat afterwards (subsequently gelded) but will probably need a career best to make a winning return after ten months off.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced Godolphin colt whose reasonably consistent sprint form features a good effort (beaten two short heads) at Newmarket; may be capable of progress now handicapping and upped to 7f; solid claims.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who proved suited by the step up to 7f in Epsom maiden (good to firm) most recently, justifying favouritism by 1l; may build on that win and show further progress kept to same distance.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Justified favouritism over 6f at York (good to firm) last time, building on her eye-catching 5f effort; out of a 7f 2yo scorer and looks open to additional improvement upped further in trip; enters calculations.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Perhaps failed to improve in holding on only narrowly at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) but backed up his debut promise and, having raced only twice, may do better yet; not dismissed.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Four-race maiden who needs to rebound, having taken her first step backwards last time; ran well on nursery debut earlier in July but that was in a lower grade and on AW.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Nursery debutant whose sprint novice form features a couple of third-place finishes, latest over 5f at Lingfield; doesn't particularly give the impression he's crying out for this new trip.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who has shown steady improvement over 6f, half-length second when favourite for Windsor nursery (good to firm) most recently; bred to be suited by this step up in distance; respected.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has something to find with Regal Tiger on last-time Windsor running and that effort didn't suggest he's crying out for a return to 7f; gained his narrow novice win at Bath over 5.7f.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten in modest AW maiden six weeks ago (9.4f) but showed minor promise on her first three starts (7f-1m1f) and now makes her handicap debut at a lowly level; market may guide.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: Down the field on both 2yo starts (6f/7.4f) and showed only minor promise when fifth of seven in Southwell novice (1m, AW) on latest outing in March but remains unexposed and improvement is possible in handicaps.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: Won on nursery debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in December and returned from break with two pretty good turf runs in the spring (both 1m); below that form twice since (1m2f/1m4f) but may benefit from this drop back in trip.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: 14-race maiden; campaign mainly as a sprinter but, having been upped in trip, caught the eye finishing strongly from the rear for a close third at Hamilton (1m1f, good) a week ago; still on good mark after 2lb nudge; looks close to a breakthrough.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten over 9l when fifth of seven at Ripon (1m, good) on Monday and has now been unplaced all seven starts; needs to find improvement from somewhere.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: A maiden after six runs but lost out only by a short head to Park Lane Penny in Thirsk classified (1m, good to firm) last month and also finished second in Southwell handicap (1m, AW) on Thursday; likely contender.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: Just held on from Here Comes Louie to open account in Thirsk classified (1m, good to firm) last month, her fifth start; this race is a bit stronger but she's open to further progress; respected.

RaceName: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden; close second off today's mark at Leicester last month, her final start for Hugo Palmer, but failed to build upon an encouraging stable debut when last of seven at Ripon (also 1m2f, good to firm) 12 days ago; drops back in trip here.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Dropped into a Class 3 when making all at Windsor (extended 1m3f, good to firm) and well beaten off this 5lb higher mark at Newmarket; he can be up and down, and could finish only eighth in this last year.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has history in this race, having won it two seasons ago and only a length behind Night Breeze last year (good to firm; could have done with a truer gallop); just 2lb higher than 12 months ago and perhaps unwise to come down too harshly on his defeat at Royal Ascot, especially when his comeback run was so encouraging; shortlisted.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Useful at her best in South Africa; steady progress in three runs for William Haggas, last time going close in a Class 2 1m3f handicap on the AW in December; couldn't put it past her trainer having her cherry ripe after a break for this, a race he won four years ago; stays this far but fast ground would be a first.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Had three of these behind when winning this last year off 11lb lower (good to firm); looks even better now, probably not seen to best effect behind Sportingsilvermine at Newmarket before a sterling effort at Glorious Goodwood over an inadequate 1m2f; likes it here and he's hard to knock.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won 1m4f/2m handicaps on the AW early this year; only 3-38 on turf but quite encouraging runs in hot 1m3f/1m6f handicaps before finishing tailed off at Newmarket after starting slowly (1m4f); it wouldn't be a bolt from the blue should he run well but others are safer.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Seen mostly at up to 1m4f so perhaps unwise to read all that much into last two defeats over 2m and 1m6f; not impossibly treated on his solid 1m4f form earlier this season, and last year's efforts included a 2l defeat in this (not seen to best effect) and a victory over Insanity at York (1m4f, good to firm); in the mix.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Can race freely and hooded for his last two races at York, in the latest finishing a highly respectable third (promoted from fourth) in the John Smith's Cup (extended 1m2f; good to firm) for which he was 4lb well in; now 3lb higher and surprisingly goes without any headgear, but he's got some momentum behind him.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: His 1m4f win on good to firm at Newmarket in July reads well but has finished behind Castle Stuart in their recent clashes and beat only one home in the John Smith's Cup four weeks ago; probably vulnerable off this mark.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Veteran with ten wins to his name; behind some of these on two visits to York this summer but wasn't disgraced in a C&D handicap 15 days ago on a rare foray over this far; could have some part to play.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Looked as though he needed further than 1m when a rallying fourth at Newmarket in June and he duly obliged returned to 1m2f at Sandown; didn't have a lot in hand that day but only went up 2lb and he could approve for going even further this afternoon.

RaceName: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 250-1 academy hurdle winner for Richard Morrissey; form otherwise poor but has joined a shrewd yard ahead of handicap debut and notable that trainer rides (2-5 this season, 12-27 last season); market check advised on return from six month break.

RaceName: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Just 1-24 over hurdles and that win came in 2024; finished last season bang out of form and similar story at Galway after a break on latest; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-12 over hurdles but has run well in defeat, including when runner up in a 2m1f (good) maiden hurdle here; went close off 3lb higher at Galway in October; wide trip when midfield over C&D (good) on latest; not discounted off 2lb lower.

RaceName: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-7 over timber; was first past the post on latest at Limerick (2m4f, soft) but was disqualified for causing interference; previously went close on better ground at Punchestown so conditions no concern; should go well again off 5lb higher.

RaceName: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the mark in decisive fashion over C&D 16 days ago; a 6lb rise for that 5.5l win seems lenient and he may be hard to stop if turning up here in a similar mood.

RaceName: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Second runner for yard; modest form in bumpers and maiden hurdles on varying ground; tongue tie goes on for handicap debut; best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Very lightly raced for her age; posted a personal best when justifying strong support in 24-runner Kensington Palace Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm), leading late on; still unexposed and well worth her place in this higher grade.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: 0-9 on turf; ran as well as she's ever done on grass when beaten neck in six-runner handicap at Leopardstown (1m, good) three weeks ago, but that still leaves her with a fair bit to find on these terms.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won three 1m Group 1s last year on good or good to yielding ground; well below form on final 4yo start and she folded tamely when last of four in Group 2 Middleton Fillies' Stakes at York (1m2f, good) on reappearance, when lack of stamina was possibly a factor; takes a significant drop in grade and she's the one to beat if back to her best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: J Fyffe, A Edmondson & L McGurty
Spotlight: Regularly makes the frame and she ran up to her best when third in Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; this is tougher but she still has each-way possibilities.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won Musselburgh handicap (1m1f, good) in good style in April but has since come up short in Listed race here and Group 2 at Ascot (1m, good to firm; last of 15); will need a career best but she's relatively low mileage.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Progressive type who followed an unlucky fifth to Alobayyah in handicap at Royal Ascot with a narrow win in similar event at Goodwood (1m, good) 11 days ago; this is a sterner assignment but it's unlikely she's reached her ceiling just yet.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Reliable 3yo; creditable second in French Listed race (1m, good to soft) two weeks ago, but this looks a much more competitive affair and she has plenty to find on the figures.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Beaten only once in four outings as a 2yo, crowning the campaign with a gutsy success in Group 3 at Newmarket (7f, good); should have no problem getting 1m; still has untapped potential and she's an interesting candidate if ready to roll after ten months off.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Progressive 2yo campaign culminated in fine second in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf; below par in Listed race at York (possibly needed run) and Group 3 at Epsom (ground possibly softer than ideal) this term; some questions to answer but she's a leading player if back to her best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Ran as well as could have been expected when 80-1 for the 1,000 Guineas in May; still rather green but stuck to her task well when second in Listed race at Sandown (1m, good to firm; 11-1) five weeks ago; needs more progress but she's going the right way.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; by Lope De Vega and first foal of German 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Listed; RPR 101) whose siblings include useful 1m-1m2f scorer (including 2yo) Greatgadian; may not flourish until sent over longer trips.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; by Churchill; sibling to eight winners, notably Ventura Storm (1m-12.5f including 2yo/Italian Group 1; 115); dam maiden; brings the lowest price tag among the runners who went through the sales ring.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 240,000gns yearling; by Justify and first foal of 6f 2yo/French 1m Listed scorer (RPR 105) whose siblings include 8.5f Canadian Grade 3 winners Grizzel; not ideal to see headgear (hood) fitted so early; market may offer further guidance.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 98,000gns yearling, then topped the 2026 Arqana May Breeze Up Sale by fetching 1,100,000euros; Sioux Nation half-sister to 1m 2yo/1m1f winner Port Darwin (RPR 66); dam 5.5f-6.5f scorer (including German Listed; 104), out of 6.7f/7f Group 3 winner; wears tongue-tie; stable is operating at an impressive strike-rate with 2yos this term and landed this race last year with a seven-figure Arqana breeze-up buy; very interesting.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 140,000gns yearling; by Supremacy; sibling to two winners, notably Sayidah Dariyan (6f including 2yo/Group 3; 115); dam French 7f scorer, sister to 5f Group 2 winner Finsbury Square; likely type on breeding.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 260,000gns yearling; Mehmas half-sister to winners Topteam (10.3f/1m4f; RPR 96) and Queen Tamara (7f 2yo; 79); dam runner-up 1m4f, half-sister to Group-placed 1m 2yo/1m2f scorer King's Gambit; market confidence behind this Gosden runner should be noted.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 300,000gns yearling; by Lope De Vega; sister to 1m1f winner Queen Of The Bogs (RPR 94); dam 1m-1m2f scorer (including AW Group 3; 106), half-sister to Australian 1m1f/1m2f Group 1 winner Delius; one of the likelier sorts based on sales information.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Slightly disappointing off this career-high mark when dropped back to 7f at Yarmouth last month but won twice over the straight 1m there (good to firm) in June and further progress is not yet out of the question.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Placed off marks slightly higher than today's four consecutive times in May/June, the last twice at York (1m1f/1m, good); not quite at same level on last two outings but still enters calculations.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Not quite at best this season but exploited some help from the handicapper when winning narrowly at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month and ought to remain competitive after going back up 4lb.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Caused 33-1 surprise on stable debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in January and rebounded from lesser effort when second over the straight 1m at Ascot (good to firm; winner followed up soon afterwards) last month; considered.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Strong traveller who sometimes flatters to deceive; close second to a recent Glorious Goodwood winner on latest turf start, at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) in June, and also ran well on AW last month but has modest 2-32 strike-rate and others appeal more for win purposes; usually wears blinkers or cheekpieces but goes only in a first-time tongue-tie here.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Ex-Irish 5yo; started off for current stable with two good runs over 1m in the spring but has suffered a worrying slump in form since and needs to be perked up by the addition of a visor.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Clearcut winner in first-time cheekpieces at Pontefract (1m, good) in June and probably bettered that form when very close second at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month but was below form after racing too freely over C&D three weeks ago and needs to bounce back with a career best.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Just a respectable fourth of seven over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago but that run came after a short break and he's now well handicapped if judged on some of this spring's form; worth a second look.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Kept on well to score at Pontefract (1m, good) last month and is now 2-7; 5lb higher in a more competitive race here might still have more to offer.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Showed career-best form when scoring at York (1m, good to firm) last month and was denied clear run in closing stages when very respectable fifth at Ascot (7f, good to firm) a fortnight later; still unexposed over 1m and remains very much of interest.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Unexposed after only five starts but finished well down the field when 66-1 for seasonal/stable debut at Haydock (1m, good) three months ago; not seen since; considered only if much stronger in the betting here.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Beaten under 1l when third of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now made the frame six consecutive times; holds no secrets from the handicapper but ought to give another good account.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
Spotlight: Safely held on all three starts for Grant Tuer this spring but has since been given a wind op; makes stable debut from a good mark; well worth a glance in the betting.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Gained all five wins over 7f; went close over that trip in Class 6 event at regular haunt Catterick (good to firm) last month but went up 2lb for that and looks vulnerable over 1m in this stronger race.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Useful 2yo, winning the Windsor Castle over 5f here last June and running creditably in Group 2 company on a couple of occasions; he has offered more than enough this year to think he had trained on and his mark is slowly dropping; gelded since latest start and one to consider back up to 6f; cheekpieces worn on last two starts are now discarded.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: 6f novice win as a 2yo; better form when fourth in a Listed race at Chantilly (6.5f, AW) in March but less good twice since; 7f and heavy ground are valid excuses for the last two runs and he is not yet fully exposed.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Unplaced in his two attempts at sprinting this summer but he hasn't run badly on either occasion; could have a bigger effort brewing.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Thriving since dropped to 6f, winning at Ripon and Hamilton in May and then performing with great credit in hot sprint handicaps on his last three starts; no obvious reason why he wouldn't be bang there once again.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Just one win to her name from her nine starts but that doesn't do her ability justice as she has regularly acquitted herself well in the face of stiff tasks, most recently finishing close up in a Group 3 at York (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; interesting on this belated handicap debut.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Five runs as a 2yo, winning on debut (6f, good to firm) and ending his campaign with near misses at Windsor and Salisbury (6f, good to soft and good); gelded during his 310-day absence; career best required.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Two wins as a 2yo, notably a sales race at Newmarket (7f, good); not so good in 2026 but his mark is easing; hooded for this first run for Stuart Williams (sold out of Oliver Cole's yard for 65,000gns last month).

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Made a winning seasonal/handicap debut at Pontefract (6f, good) in April; flopped behind Thunder Call at York eight weeks ago; that run casts a shadow but he still has low mileage and could well rebound.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Easy win in a 6f maiden at Kempton on his reappearance in May; made light of his opening mark when seeing off 21 rivals in a 6f handicap at York (good) in June; unable to justify favouritism in a hot Newmarket handicap last month but the ground was the fastest he has faced and he didn't look entirely at ease, doing well to take third as things panned out; that form looks strong and he remains with serious potential; of obvious interest if the going is deemed suitable.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Suited by the drop to 6f, winning a Ripon maiden in June and following up on his handicap debut at Chester in July (both good ground); only fifth of seven off this mark back at Chester two weeks ago; further progress essential.

RaceName: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner is 0-3 over fences and hasn't troubled the judge; soundly beaten over C&D the last twice; new cheekpieces need to eke out more.

RaceName: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner (solid form) bounced back from a poor Punchestown novice hurdle run to finish a close third on chase debut over 2m here in June (0.5l behind William Tell); this longer trip fine and every chance.

RaceName: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Well held behind William Tell and Nadia's Boy in a 2m beginners' here in June; no match for Charlie Luciano upped to 25.5f at Kilbeggan latest; this trip more suitable but he's 0-7 over fences now and needs to find more to get his head in front.

RaceName: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner; extended chase record to 0-7 when a 14.5l third of 9 over C&D on debut for this yard last month but may have needed that after 208 days off and could get closer now; rated 114 and in the mix.

RaceName: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Went close on chase bow here (2m) in June (Nadia's Boy and Scalpnagoon behind) but unseated back here next time and out of depth in hot 2m2f Galway beginners' chase on latest; this looks less demanding, this longer trip will suit and he is a leading contender with rider claiming valuable 7lb.

RaceName: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Won over hurdles when trained in France on very soft; 66-1 and beaten 35l on debut for this stable in a Limerick Grade 3 novice hurdle; this more realistic and bred to make a chaser but best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Better than ever when landing a second 7f Goodwood success of the year in 20-runner event at last week's Glorious meeting (good to firm), with the reopposing Pellitory well behind; a further 4lb rise seems unlikely to prevent another prominent showing from this thriving 5yo.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time 7f turf winner who was close to career-best form when second of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) last month but he weakened to finish well adrift of Crimson Spirit at Goodwood last week.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer; now 1lb lower than for last August's win at Chester (7.6f, good to firm) but his two York efforts this summer have been underwhelming.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Mixed form this season but last two efforts creditable and the way his challenge petered out late on over 1m at Ascot a fortnight ago suggests this return to 7f could prove ideal.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Reappeared with close third at Redcar in April but hasn't built on it, including last of 15 at Thirsk last weekend; hopes are pinned on a first-time visor having a revitalising effect with Oisin Murphy taking the reins.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins over 6f at Kempton, latterly a handicap 59 days ago, but she was second in a C&D maiden on good last August; hit with a 7lb rise for that latest success but she's a lightly raced filly from a yard in fine form so further progress wouldn't surprise.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Has developed into a useful 7f handicapper; excusable effort at Royal Ascot is flanked by good performances, namely a ready success at Doncaster and sixth-place finish in the International at Ascot; still on career-high mark but can't be dismissed.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 5f; proved useful (twice Listed placed) last term; well below par in two runs this season but gives the impression he has possibly lost some of his speed; may prove resurgent upped in distance with hood fitted on handicap debut.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Well treated on best Listed/Group form but has lost her solidity and was soundly beaten in Royal Ascot handicap (1m) most recently; still on a losing sequence that goes back to May 2024.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Record since wearing blinkers comprises a win at Chepstow, creditable sixth in competitive field at York and excusable effort (race didn't go smoothly) at Glorious Goodwood; could go well in the retained headgear.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Gained most recent success in AW Vase race on Good Friday; has steadily got back into the swing of turf racing and went very close at Thirsk (7f) last Saturday, running at least as well as he's ever done; the signs are positive.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Scored three times for previous yard but is 0-8 for current stable and not particularly solid on 2026 form that includes mostly duck eggs, beaten 8l with tongue-tie fitted at Glorious Goodwood most recently; perhaps best watched unless the market speaks favourably.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
OwnerName: D J Cash & Mrs E Cash Racing
Spotlight: Back on last winning mark but is by no means certain to take advantage, having finished last of nine at Doncaster on seasonal debut; admittedly may fare better with that outing under his belt.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: One win apiece for his previous two yards; 0-4 this season for new stable but is in form, close fifth at Ascot most recently; getting no respite from the assessor, so the 7lb claimed by Olivia Haines looks a help.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Showed major promise (won then good third) in two AW starts last autumn/winter; failed to transfer the form to turf in C&D handicap at the July festival but may do better still, being such a lightly raced 4yo.

RaceName: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
Spotlight: Built on debut promise by completing a Newmarket double (7f/6f) last October and the form has received several boosts since; came off a true line last time but may keep straighter with headgear now applied; open to further progress and commands respect on handicap/seasonal debut, especially if the betting speaks positively.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Free-going front-runner; no longer the force of old but ran big race when fourth of 23 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last week; 1lb lower here and could be hard to catch if in similar form again.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Placed three consecutive times in May-July, most recently when close second off today's mark at York (5f, good to firm); behind Democracy Dilemma when mid-pack in big field at Glorious Goodwood last week but that certainly wasn't a bad run; can make his presence felt.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: 6-18 on AW but 0-10 on turf when trained by Robert Cowell; sold for 27,000gns after disappointing AW run in June; makes stable debut from a workable mark but others in this field have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Made all off 1lb lower at Chester (6f, good) in May and wasn't beaten far on any of four subsequent starts there, the latest over 5f from a tough draw; may not be seen to quite the same effect on this straight track, though.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Gained all three wins on Tapeta but kept on well for close second of 17 on turf at York (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and is respected off just 2lb higher here.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: An improver this season, with his only blip coming on heavy ground in the Italian Derby; got messed about when fourth of the six runners in a 1m2f handicap at Newmarket a month ago (good to firm); not yet exposed and Ryan Moore rides.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Stable has captured two of the last four renewals, and this filly is on a roll after completing a hat-trick over C&D a month ago; that was by the skin of her teeth but the second was an improver and the pair were clear; she probably won that day in spite of the steady gallop; strong contender under Saffie Osborne.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Competitive in both his handicaps (1m4f) for George Boughey and left that yard for £170,000; likely to win races for Ian Williams, but he was pulled up after never going at Goodwood only ten days ago (1m4f, good to firm; 25-1) and headgear is soon turned to.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Races prominently; 0-5 but bounced back from heavy defeat in Royal Ascot handicap (80-1) to go close over C&D last month (good to firm); raised 2lb for that but ceiling of his ability wouldn't be known just yet.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Irish stable won this two years ago; placed in both his handicaps, the latest when headed late on in the Ulster Derby at Down Royal (1m5f, soft); suffered another narrow defeat when the standard-setter in a 1m4f maiden at the Curragh (good to firm); hard to call him progressive, but trainer always respected on her forays here and cheekpieces are a first.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Came from behind for clearcut win at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) but couldn't get past the leader when attempting the same trick at Salisbury; that was under a very capable 5lb claimer off this mark, so has more on her plate now promoted from a Class 5.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: This year's wins at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) and Thirsk (1m4f, good) were from the front; last two defeats suggest his progress may have levelled out, for all that he was tried over 1m6f both times; probably needs his best yet.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 1m2f AW novice winner last year; probably needed his comeback run and ran appreciably better at Chester last week (1m4f, good) when he conceded a head start to an in-form filly; stable has a good record at this meeting; respected.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: His nursery win (sole success) was on soft but conditions were good to firm when second to Last Verse in a small field at Chepstow (1m4f), since when he's finished tailed off here after suffering early interference; needs his best form yet even if putting best foot forward.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Bought for 20,000gns out of Andrew Balding's yard after winning off 5lb lower at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces); ran okay at Sandown but no more than that in a small field over 1m6f; his new rider will have to navigate from the widest stall.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Back to form with fine effort under positive ride in big field at Galway on latest; has gone well over this C&D before so obvious chance off the same mark as last time.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 3-22 over fences (including a 2m win here); back from 114 days off with respectable run at Downpatrick on latest (19.5f, good); sharper for that but probably not much margin for error off current mark.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 1-9 over fences; hasn't really fired in 2026 and failed to exploit lower hurdles mark at Galway on latest when 28-1; needs to rediscover best.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Course winner over timber is 0-4 over fences but she ran a fine race in a handicap chase over 2m here back in May when a 1.25l second; didn't back it up off 2lb higher on her next start and jumped poorly when pulled up here latest; needs to bounce back upped in trip.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Bumper winner; yet to show much over fences and his second here on latest was an extremely remote one (beaten 70l, just two finished); cheekpieces go on now for handicap chase debut; not easy to make a case for.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Landed a handicap chase at Killarney in May (20.5f, gd-yld) off 7lb lower; failed to follow up off revised mark at Limerick and soundly beaten off higher hurdles mark at Galway on latest; a bit to prove for now.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Is 18lb lower than when winning at Navan in February 2023 but he's lost his way and no signs of a revival when pulled up at Killarney on latest.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden showed ability in a couple of maiden hurdles but has failed to complete in two of his four starts in 2026; pulled up in first-time blinkers at Killarney latest; blinkers tried now.

RaceName: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Veteran is a four-time chase winner (including over C&D) but hasn't won since 2024 and badly out of form when last seen at Killarney in October; entitled to need this and best watched.

Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Well backed and went down only narrowly on stable debut at Sandown (1m, good) ten days ago, just reeled in after leading over 2f out; just as effective over 7f; up 3lb but Conor Whiteley can claim a handy 5lb.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Thriving since joining Charlie Clover, justifying favouritism at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm; Napolian fourth) 11 days ago; may have more in the tank, although this is warmer and he's 5lb higher.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: 0-6; no show in first-time tongue-strap at Doncaster (80-1) on latest start; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Did just enough when winning at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in June; met trouble and fared best of those drawn high at Newbury next time; almost certainly remains in form and worth another go at 7f; interesting.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester (1m, good to firm) but hasn't cut much ice since, safely held by Norcross Brow at Beverley last time; bit to prove.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Revived with the help of cheekpieces to win at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month, and the way she kept on suggests this return to 7f will be fine; leading contender if the headgear works a second time.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Gained breakthrough success at Ffos Las (extended 7f, good) in June and ran respectably when second there next time; this race may be a little warmer but she should be in the mix again.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he's knocking at the door, short of room when second of six at Sandown (7f, good to firm) on most recent outing; Oisin Murphy is a positive booking and the first-time visor could be an extra boost; high on the list.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Off mark in 6f Wolverhampton novice in February but has failed to repeat the form; never dangerous upped to 7f last time; others preferred.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Handicap debutant who has to overcome top weight and a near year-long absence but is worth noting if the market speaks favourably; faced a difficult task in the 2025 Solario when last seen; won on AW the time before.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned over 7f last year and 6f this term; went close on the other course at Newmarket on reappearance but has regressed in two runs since; chance depends on the effects of new trip and first-time headgear.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Broadly progressive form switched to handicaps this term features a win at Carlisle; far from disgraced when one of several late closers behind the well-supported winner in big field at Glorious Goodwood (kept to 1m) most recently; shortlisted.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Has failed to back up a good reappearance effort and finished behind two of today's rivals, albeit having raced wide, at Glorious Goodwood most recently (first run since being gelded); something to prove.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Has built up a stronger record on AW than on turf and may be more interesting when back in that sphere; behind Runswick when fitted with cheekpieces at Glorious Goodwood last time; headgear retained.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Disappointing at York last time; has proved consistent otherwise and may rebound, provided he takes well to first-time headgear; 0-7 on turf but went very close at Yarmouth (1m) on penultimate outing.

RaceName: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Hat-trick seeker who has very low mileage; the form of his Class 5 success at Newbury (1m, good to firm; handicap debut) last time has been franked by the runner-up since; upped in grade but receives weight all round and looks open to further progress; respected.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds and put in fairly good front-running shift when third of six in this grade at Wolverhampton (5f, AW; refitted hood) last week, his second start for Derek Shaw; also suited by turf but others appeal more all the same.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won this race a year ago and has made the frame in handicaps on her last four appearances; about 1l behind Gwen Tennyson at Catterick (5f, good to firm) on Tuesday and 2lb worse off with her today but still likely to be in the shake-up.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Lost his way in the spring but, following a two-month break, was placed off reduced mark at Newcastle (5f, AW) a fortnight ago; today's return to turf is probably not ideal but he still enters calculations on first dip into this basement grade.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Runner-up off her basement handicap mark on stable debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) in June and also ran well when fourth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last month; not really favoured by today's weights but can give another good account.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Dual 6f AW winner; returned from break with low-key turf run over that trip last month and has never run over 5f before; swaps visor (worn for last six races) for refitted cheekpieces; others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Consistent in handicaps for Noel Wilson this year, signing off for him with a second at Newcastle (5f, AW) a fortnight ago; dips into this basement grade for stable debut (same owners) and has the services of Cieren Fallon; good chance.

RaceName: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
Spotlight: A maiden after eight starts but attracted some market support before a back-to-form second in Catterick handicap (5f, good to firm) on Tuesday; will pose a potent threat if in similar mood again here.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Finished second behind Ebt's Guard in this race 12 months ago when rated 14lb lower; he has earned his lofty rating since then, winning twice at Goodwood last autumn and recording a career-best RPR when second of 18 in the Golden Mile at Goodwood eight days ago; another big run anticipated.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Won a valuable 7f handicap here last summer before bolting up in the Stewards' Cup one week later; another fine course run here last month when second of 16 and he was heavily supported for a Stewards' Cup repeat, only to stumble leaving the stalls; that run is easily excused but he is back up 2lb today and his stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: He has returned from the Middle East with fine efforts at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) and over 1m on the straight course here (good to firm) in July; should remain competitive under these conditions.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Won handicaps at Newmarket and Epsom this summer before finishing down the field in the Royal Hunt Cup; only 14th of 18 at Goodwood (1m, good to firm) eight days ago but that doesn't tell the story of his run as he was travelling well but with nowhere to go for most of the home straight; he will need a career best to win but it is not out of the question.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Defied a 5lb lower mark in the corresponding race 12 months ago; many good runs in defeat since then, including his fourth in the Royal Hunt Cup, and he is unlikely to be too far away.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Progressive 3yo last year; gelded prior to finishing down the field in the Buckingham Palace Stakes here (7f, good to firm) at the Royal meeting, a run that is easily excused given his draw; now tongue tied; not fully exposed at 1m and he is one to consider.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Strong handicap form last summer, runner-up in both Ascot runs (1m, straight course) before landing a valuable prize at York's Ebor meeting; only 1lb higher today after a couple of low-key runs in May; interesting with cheekpieces now given a go.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Solid fourth-place finishes in good handicaps at Epsom and Sandown on his last two starts; suspicion he will prove vulnerable for win purposes.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Useful form in Europe prior to joining Ian Williams; he has some uninspiring form figures but they don't tell the whole story as he ran well in the Royal Hunt Cup and had a torrid passage in the Golden Mile at Goodwood eight days ago; edging down the weights and has the assistance of Ryan Moore in the saddle; could go well.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Four runs for Mike Murphy have yielded three heavy defeats and a shock 1m2f win at Windsor in May; opposable on balance of form.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Has gone the wrong way since winning the 2024 Cork National; signs of a revival over hurdles at Sligo on penultimate but didn't build on it back there on latest; remains 5lb above his last chase win and failed to complete last two chase starts.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Arrives in terrific form, winning over hurdles at Listowel in late May and then scoring in a beginners' over 19.5f (good) here on his chase debut; he's a brother of Scottish National winner Captain Cody so should stay this far and his opening mark looks workable; should go well on handicap chase debut.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Both wins for this yard have come on rain softened ground at around 2m4f; had been in decent form over timber before pulling up at Killarney last time (2m7f, good, jockey reported never travelled); may need softer ground.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner got off the mark over fences here on latest (2m7f, good), beating Teenage Kiss by a neck off 105; 7lb rise mostly negated by rider's claim; this is a deeper race so further improvement will be required, but that's not impossible; stamina assured.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
Spotlight: In fine form over hurdles this year (won over 3m here in May) and very encouraging start to chasing career when beaten a neck behind Rue Taylor here on latest; nudged up 4lb but likely to be bang there again.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Gained first chase win over C&D (good) just 17 days ago, bolting up by 11l; on the face of it, a 6lb rise for that looks a shade lenient but it probably wasn't the strongest of races and this is tougher; likes it here but needs to improve again to follow up.

RaceName: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
OwnerName: Desmond O'Brien & John T O'Neill & J P Flavin
Spotlight: Course winner over 19.5f in 2024 off 5lb lower; won a couple of handicap hurdles last year but out of form so far in 2026 and well held behind two of these over C&D on latest; others appeal more.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Knuckled down well to justify favouritism here on reappearance but hasn't made the expected further progress; seems to stay 1m but all three successes remain at 7f; concedes weight all round; others preferred.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Followed six duck eggs with a last-gasp win at Thirsk (1m, good) last Saturday under Seamus Cronin, capitalising on some leniency from the handicapper; nudged back up only 2lb; has possibilities if on another going day.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Back to form when beaten a nose at Doncaster three weeks ago; 3lb lower than last winning mark and seems to retain all his ability, so a serious contender if staying the trip (all wins at 6f/7f).

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Has gone off big odds and finished well held on last three starts, latest on reappearance after being gelded; slipping in the weights but needs a revival.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Gained comfortable novice wins at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) and Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) on first two outings, before fading when seventh in 1m2f Group 3 at Royal Ascot; still low mileage and may well be suited by stepping back down in distance; interesting in first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Failed to make the frame on first four starts this season but revived with a 7l win in four-runner race at Salisbury (1m, good to firm); what that form is worth is open to question and he's back up 7lb, but at least the third has won since.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Both his wins have come on the AW but he wasn't disgraced when eighth of 17 on turf at York (7f, good; 22-1) four weeks ago; stepping back up to 1m should be a help; each-way possibilities.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: All three wins at 7f including at Doncaster (good to firm) in June; has remained in form but he's drawn wide and may not be quite so effective over 1m.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; faded after being pestered for the lead in German Group 2 in May, but he'd previously posted a personal best when second to the high-class Talk Of New York in conditions race at Newmarket (7f, good) on reappearance; bred to stay at least 1m; makes handicap debut and might have been let in lightly.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
Spotlight: Well treated on the pick of his form for Hugo Palmer last year but was 66-1 and showed little on reappearance/stable debut; only 2lb lower and probably best watched.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: Fine Claret Racing,Mrs Burke & C Wood
Spotlight: Consistent form since being gelded, gaining a deserved success in five-runner race at Hamilton (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; just 2lb higher and should go well again.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor
Spotlight: Had slipped in the weights before winning at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in July, and he ran at least as well over 1m at York next time; should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Unplaced last five starts, not really finishing his races; carries obvious risks but his three turf wins came over 1m on good to firm ground and he now returns after a wind operation; he's well handicapped if the surgery has had a positive effect.
