Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
Spotlight: Tough and consistent sort who made all over C&D (good to firm) under Chloe Lyons last Saturday; raised 5lb but likely to give it his usual good shot.

RaceName: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
Spotlight: 6yo who is well handicapped on last season's best efforts for Michael Bell and made quite an encouraging start for his new yard when third of seven at Sandown (5f, good to firm) 16 days ago, particularly as he was tight for room against the rail; given a chance to build on that with Billy Loughnane taking the reins this time.

RaceName: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Leicester maiden (5f, good) on stable debut last July but has found it harder in handicaps since, including sixth of seven on Lingfield (turf) reappearance a fortnight ago.

RaceName: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer who made it three wins in his last five starts when making all at Musselburgh (5f, good) last Friday; it's over three years since he defied a mark this high but he has to be respected in his current mood.

RaceName: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win on turf, but is now 2lb lower than when scoring on Tapeta at Newcastle (5f) in February and he did well under the circumstances when fourth of 11 at Ayr (5f, good to firm) 26 days ago, faring best of those from off the pace (started slowly); a rare Newmarket runner for his Scottish stable.

RaceName: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner who won a Lingfield AW novice last August; best effort in handicaps when second at Southwell (5f, AW) under Chloe Lyons (who partners stablemate Merrimack here) in April but well held back on turf the following month; off since.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Not seen on the Flat since narrow AW win over this trip in October but placed twice over hurdles in recent weeks; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Dual hurdle winner since joining Iain Jardine in the autumn and a very respectable fourth of 13 on the Flat at York (2m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; contests this easier race from the same mark; must be considered.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Came good for current stable at fifth attempt, in tactical four-runner race at Doncaster (extended 1m6f, good to firm) last month but was behind Newport when down the field at York a fortnight later; others have more convincing profiles.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Began this season with two good efforts in May (1m4f/1m6f) and is well handicapped if judged on those but was soundly beaten on last two starts and comes here with a point to prove; blinkered last time; usual cheekpieces now refitted.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; ought to have coped better with the soft ground when beaten 55l on final start last season and was again tailed off when reappearing on AW last month; now sports first-time tongue-tie and visor; others have much less to prove.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Beat his three rivals fairly comfortably when back on turf here (2m, good to firm) three weeks ago and is evidently in good nick but a recent 4lb rise might be enough to leave this 10yo vulnerable.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner over 1m4f, most recently at Pontefract (good) last month; bumped into very well-handicapped rival when second at Thirsk (1m4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and looks interesting over this new trip.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to be placed after six starts but made satisfactory seasonal debut over 1m2f last month and could quite plausibly be seen to better effect over this longer trip; well worth keeping an eye on in the betting.

RaceName: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
Spotlight: Struggled on last month's handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and didn't achieve a great deal when seventh of ten in slowly run race at Southwell (1m3f, AW) soon afterwards; remains lightly raced but needs to take a big step forward over this new trip.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Won a beginners chase at Roscommon in good style last summer (16.5f, yielding); hasn't fired since and unseated at the first on seasonal return here in June; others make more appeal.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Versatile mare scored on the Flat at Tramore (2m, good) on her latest outing; her sole win from five chase starts came in in this race last year (good) off 107; 5lb higher here but arrives in form and can't be discounted.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-2 over fences but shaped like his turn was near here on penultimate when chasing home Rockonliam (19.5f, good); hampered and unseated at the first on latest at Galway; chance, but might prefer more of a stamina test.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Point and hurdles winner (here) ran a nice race over C&D on latest under a positive ride, beaten just 2.25l by Ballybrittas on her second chase start; the third from that race has since run well at Galway so she is interesting off just 2lb higher.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt over fences over this C&D 17 days ago, beating Lady Doyanne by 2.25l; 6lb higher now but some of that is negated by his rider's claim; should be on the premises again.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sent off at just 9-2 on return from mammoth absence in a handicap hurdle here 16 days ago (16.5f, good) and denied only by a neck; capable off this mark over fences but the 'bounce' factor has to be a concern and has fallen both previous chase runs at this venue.

RaceName: Betway Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Third AW success in his last four starts when comfortably on top over the extended 1m at Wolverhampton eight days ago; he does need to prove he's as effective on turf (0-5 but was second in a nursery on soft last year) but he had them well strung out at Dunstall Park and could still be well treated even after a further 7lb rise.

RaceName: Betway Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: No great progress in AW handicaps from last October to January but he found a powerful finish to make a successful return to turf at Newmarket (1m, good) in June; beaten at short odds but still matched that winning RPR when runner-up back there (good to firm) a week later; freshened up since; considered.

RaceName: Betway Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Rallied well in first-time visor dropped back to 1m at Sandown (good to firm) last week but only fifth under a penalty at Newmarket (1m, good to firm again) on Thursday; will run off 2lb lower if turned out again quickly.

RaceName: Betway Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when winning at Carlisle (7f, good) in June; has matched that form when runner-up around 1m on good to firm off this mark on both starts since; likely to be on the premises again.

RaceName: Betway Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Got up late to shed her maiden tag at the 12th attempt at Wolverhampton (8.6f) 18 days ago; comfortably held on both turf starts but it's too soon to suggest she won't prove as effective on the grass.

RaceName: Betway Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: String of poor efforts at huge prices this season; expect more of the same.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas; seems to be improving gradually over hurdles; decent fourth over C&D two weeks ago; non-runner 4.45 Wexford Friday

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a 1m Naas handicap on yielding two years ago; a couple of solid runs in Flat handicaps of late, including when third in a 1m1f Ballinrobe contest in May; hurdling debut here.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up in maiden hurdles at Clonmel in May and Punchestown in June; failed to match that form at Wexford last month; more like it when fourth in a Flat handicap at Tramore four days later.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Fourth foal; brother to 1m4f/13.5f winner Golden Bugle (RPR 90), half-brother to 1m winner Golden Love (59); dam 1m winner (inc Listed; 107), half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Footstepsinthesand and 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Pedro The Great; good Flat pedigree; certainly of interest on his track debut.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed three times in maiden hurdles at this venue and probably his best effort was when runner-up in a 2m3f contest two weeks ago; worth dropping back in trip and sets a fair standard; likely to be the one to beat.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Touched off in a Down Royal Flat maiden last year; might have been a bit closer at Ballinrobe last time but for a mistake two out; should not be too far away.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the track for 13 months after a reasonably promising debut in a Hereford bumper; well beaten in a Naas bumper in January when last seen; worth watchng though on his hurdles bow.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: In contention when stumbling and falling two out on hurdling debut at Clonmel; still looked raw when third at Ballinrobe last month; should contend.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Second foal; dam useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Soul Emotion, out of French 2m1f hurdle/chase winning half-sister to useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Helium; home-bred newcomer best watched on this occasion.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Close third on the second of two point-to-points in March; probably best watched this time.

RaceName: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Nothing to recommend her on based on three moderate runs.

RaceName: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major Ltd & Hicky Parmar Racing
Spotlight: Back to winning ways in 2m course handicap (good to firm) under Mason Paetel in June, with reopposing Dereham 5l back in third; good third of 12 in competitive Market Rasen handicap hurdle (extended 2m4f, good) since; likely to go well back on the Flat.

RaceName: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Positive start for the Charlie Clover yard, readily landing a small-field affair at Lingfield (1m5f, good to firm) in June; beaten favourite but bettered that winning RPR when second (well clear of rest) at Nottingham (1m6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; gets the vote.

RaceName: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Won five in a row at around 1m4f on turf/AW for the Charltons between September 2023 and July 2024; suffered heavy defeats on first three starts back from an absence for new yard and latest second of three at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) in this headgear combination was no big step back in the right direction as he was beaten 8l.

RaceName: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-French filly who capitalised on a reduced mark when gaining a first win at the 14th attempt in 1m6f handicap at Redcar (good) in June; creditable second of four over 2m there (good to firm) since, both under today's rider Cian Horgan.

RaceName: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: 10yo whose last three wins (in 2022, 2023 and 2025) came in the 2m handicap he contested here six weeks ago; could only manage 5l third to the reopposing Prince Quattro in this year's renewal; 4lb better off with that rival this time but it may not be enough.

RaceName: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came in a 2m AW handicap for Dominic Ffrench Davis last June but he went very close to a second on just his second outing for Michael Wigham when short-headed at Lingfield (extended 2m, good to firm) under Alexandra Egan 17 days ago; the first-time visor he wore at Lingfield is retained.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has probably performed to a similar level in both his races, Class 5 maidens at 6f; beaten under 2l at Chepstow in the latest and this isn't a strong race.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs T Burns And Rjh Ltd
Spotlight: Slow to break and never involved when kicking off over 7f at Musselburgh (13-2) last week.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing, J Craggs & Partner
Spotlight: Went off at 6-4 when only sixth on debut at Beverley where he was getting the hang of things late on, but then finished last of six at Newcastle (again over 5f); steps up in trip with a hood added and might be one for nurseries later.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed good speed when second at Thirsk (6f) in July but he disappointed when one of the favourites at Catterick since; might be the yard's second string here.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: May have his quirks as he carried his head awkwardly when a front-running third at Newcastle (7f, AW) and then dropped away when fitted with cheekpieces at Nottingham (6f); might be about to become frustrating.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £16,000 breeze-up buy; sixth foal; closely related to 6f AW 2yo winner River Blackwater (RPR 64), half-brother to 1m winner Ravishing Beauty (73); dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (105); already gelded and would need to see some confidence behind him in the betting.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Minor form in both his runs, the latest last week at Thirsk; steps up from 5f.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Played her part in a strong gallop when a fading fourth on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) and that wasn't too bad a run on reflection; could feature.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Connections declining nurseries after four defeats and her 6f form is up there in this company; should have a say.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Record of 1-13 for Richard Hannon but he made a bright start for his new yard when beating 25 rivals at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) last Wednesday; up 4lb for that narrow success but he did well to overcome trouble and is a major player again on this drop back in grade.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Flopped at York two weeks ago but that was after two placed efforts including a near-miss at Thirsk (6f, good) in June; still looks feasibly treated on that form and has possibilities if she can bounce back.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Landed the odds with an emphatic win on handicap debut here (1m, good) in May; placed in two of his three runs since including when runner-up under a prominent ride at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last month; now returns to sprinting but he's still lightly raced and could make another bold bid.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Won a C&D maiden (good to firm) last May but she's struggled since switched to handicaps and has failed to beat a rival in her last two runs; mark is tumbling but she needs a major revival on this drop back in trip; tongue-tie is removed and blinkers are now tried.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Newcastle (6f, AW) last December and he's been placed there in three of his last four runs including when runner-up over 5f last week; on same mark here but his best efforts have been on Tapeta and he's been well held in last four turf runs; some risks attached.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Won an Ayr maiden (6f, good) and a C&D novice (good to firm) last August; some fair runs in handicaps this season, but he's not easy to predict and was beaten a long way with cheekpieces added at York last time; stablemate of Bleep Test.

RaceName: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
OwnerName: J Raybould N Skinner D Jenkins
Spotlight: Made it 2-5 on AW when beating Brave Traveller at Newcastle (5f) last Friday; 2lb lower back on turf but he's 0-7 in this sphere and has form figures of 68008 on grass this season; not hard to have reservations.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Pastorius filly cost 25,000Euros as a 3yo; half-sister to French winners West Coast (2m1f hurdle) and Magic Flight (2m2f hurdle/2m3f chase); dam French 1m2f winner, sister to winners Head Lad (2m1f hurdle) and Honourmission (2m4f hurdle/2m5f chase); makes debut for in-form yard with outstanding record in bumpers; obvious leading player.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Feel Like Dancing filly; dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/2m hurdle winner On The Wild Side, out of useful 2m hurdle winner; yard 3-11 in bumpers this season and their runners always command respect; market clues can help; yard won this last year.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Yeats fily; half-sister to winners Friary Road (bumper/2m hurdle), Hardwired (2m1f-2m7f hurdle/chase) and Be Fierce (1m7f chase/2m hurdle); dam bumper (inc Listed) and 2m/2m2f hurdle winner; from family yard knows well; dam and half-brother are bumper winners; market can guide on debut.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Sister to smart 1m4f winner Highland Bling; will improve for experience on debut 29 days ago, beaten 25l into eighth at Cork; well-held by Honey Bucks on that form.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Nathaniel filly out of unraced half-sister to top-class staying hurdler Big Buck's; shaped with plenty of promise when a 1.25l second to Hilly Filly at Cork on debut 29 days ago, hitting the front a furlong and a half out before being worn down; signs of greenness that day and bound to step forward; big chance.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 2,000euro 3yo; half-sister to useful 2m4f-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Lord Of Thunder; dam unraced sister to 2m4f-2m6f hurdle/chase winner The Caddy Rose, out of unraced half-sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup third Harbour Pilot; pulled up on sole point-to-point start; big ask.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Miss Ciara McGee & Ms Denise McCourt
Spotlight: Sister to 1m4f winner Celtic Druid (inc AW; RPR 73), half-sister to 7f/1m winner Lady Scathach (86); dam well beaten 5f-1m2f (33), half-sister to 6f winner Charley's Aunt, out of 7f winning half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Miss Beabea; bred to have a chance on the Flat; probably a big ask.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Maxios filly; unraced dam closely related to bumper winner Dramalarma Lucy, out of unraced sister to Grade 1 bumper winner Lovethehigherlaw; a pedigree which appeals to this sphere for trainer who does well with small string.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Belgium/Germany (one in blinkers) but he's struggled in five runs runs for current yard (three over hurdles); dropped another 4lb but he was beaten 12l on turf here (1m5f) last time and has a lot to prove at this new trip.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Won over C&D in April and he's finished second in both runs since including a close call at Kempton (2m; cheekpieces reapplied) in June; only 1lb higher here and he's a big player again back at this track.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: All of his 13 Flat wins have been on turf and he's 0-9 on AW; returned to form with fair fourth at Bath (2m1f, good) in June but he's struggled in both subsequent runs (hurdles/Flat) and others are preferred; stablemate of Trooper.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Xxx & Chris Rees
Spotlight: Big improvement upped to 1m3f on handicap/seasonal debut when scoring at Southwell (AW) last month; held in third when favourite at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last week but this unexposed 3yo has stamina in his pedigree and he could resume his progress on this switch to a staying trip; interesting contender with blinkers added.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: 0-6 but she ran her best race so far when a clear second behind a major improver over C&D last month; nudged up 2lb but she kept on well last time and should have more to offer over this trip; respected.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Creditable fourth in a Wolverhampton handicap (1m4f, AW) in June but he's finished tailed off in three subsequent runs; overall record is now 0-8 and he has a lot to prove at this new trip.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Found improvement upped to 1m6f on handicap debut when a close third of four at Bath (firm) last week; this looks tougher on this step up to 2m but he stayed on well last time and he's a half-brother to two AW winners; in the mix.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed filly who got much closer to the target with a strong-finishing third in a Wolverhampton handicap (1m6f, AW) last month; that was promising in her final run for James Ferguson and she needs a close look on this step up to 2m.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten 9l or more in all five runs, including on his stable debut over C&D (33-1; first run since gelded) last month; that was after an absence but he needs to show a lot more on this return visit.

RaceName: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
Spotlight: Tailed off over 1m6f, 1m3f and 1m2f in three qualifying runs this summer; now goes handicapping but she needs a transformation on this step up to 2m.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner yet to score over flights; best recent effort when a close third in a 2m Tramore handicap hurdle in May; needs to bounce back from an ordinary effort in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle last month.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Went up 10lb for winning a 2m3f handicap hurdle here in May; has to bounce back from an ordinary effort at Killarney last month over this shorter trip but the booking of Jack Kennedy an obvious plus.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Winner on the Flat and very consistent of late over hurdles, most recently finishing second to a front-running winner at Cork on Monday; the one to beat if able to reproduce that.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Downpatrick maiden hurdle winner two years ago; coming down the handicap but well beaten in a pair of handicap hurdles at Ballinrobe; others preferred.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Close third in a handicap hurdle over C&D in May; ran to a similar level in a more competitive contest at Roscommon last month; one for the short list.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three runs down the field in juvenile maiden hurdles last season; has run to his level in Flat handicaps since; interesting mark and an attractive jockey booking so could well have a bit to offer here.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three runs in maiden hurdles over the winter were nott devoid of promise; decent effort in first-time blinkers in a 1m handicap at Naas last month; cheekpieces tried for the first time over hurdles today; could go well at a big price.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Some promise in a Roscommon maiden hurdle a year ago; pulled up on his second start in a handicap at Limerick in October and not seen since; others much more likely; also engaged 7.01 Wexford on Friday

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual winner over flights, most recently off 88 at Wexford three years ago; didn't run badly after a nine month break at Killarney last month and should come on for that.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts over fences; latest efforts over hurdles are no more encouraging.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three maiden runs don't give much encouragement, but could improve now handicapping.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Little impact for Pat Kelly in bumpers and maiden hurdles two years ago; ran out in a point-to-point in April; best watched on his stable debut.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten out of sight in three maiden hurdles at the end of last year; off since December and hard to fancy on the evidence so far.

RaceName: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle at Tramore a year ago; right back to form when runner-up in a handicap hurdle at Cork on Monday; suited by a sharp, left-handed track and will go close if coming here in the same form.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Scrambled home in a 5f handicap at Hamilton in May and has finished third in two of his three starts since, the latest over C&D last month; this is his first Class 6 run since the Hamilton win and he needs taking seriously.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 3lb lower than for his win in the corresponding event 12 months ago; he has won two 5f handicaps (AW and good) this year and wasn't beaten far in a Class 5 at Hamilton last week; considered.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
OwnerName: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing
Spotlight: Should be making a big impact off this mark and although he has been a shade underwhelming on turf this summer he has too much ability to leave out of calculations at this level.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Down the field on her seasonal/stable debut in May but she has run well in defeat since, including when a close second over C&D 12 days ago; runs off the same mark today and she won't need much improvement for the addition of blinkers to play a leading role.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Without a win since his 2yo days; he has run some sound races in Class 6 handicaps this year but needs to pull out more for the win; stable also runs Keep The Gold.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Thrown in on last summer's best form and there were clear signs of a revival with her third of six at Musselburgh (5f, good) eight days ago; Ethan Tindall takes off a handy 5lb and she is one to be interested in.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden but placed in 5f handicaps on his last three starts and he remains open to further progress; one to take seriously.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 0-10; pulled hard and didn't see things out when favourite for a 6f handicap here last month; now 5lb lower than for his C&D second in May so he is one to take seriously back down in distance; cheekpieces are the headgear of choice today.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hasn't matched her Irish forrm in four handicap runs for new stable; tumbling down the weights and could yet come good.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Low-level novice/maiden form but she left that behind when delivering a strong finish to lead late on her handicap debut at Musselburgh (5f, good) 47 days ago; up 2lb but she still has potential and this stiffer test at the trip should suit.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; yet to strike in 2026 but he has slipped down the weights and his latest C&D fifth was encouraging, just beginning to launch a challenge when forced to switch; each-way shout.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 0-11 but she has run well at this track, including when second over 6f last month; not quite so good back at 5f 12 days ago; vulnerable for win purposes once again.

RaceName: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up in two Goodwood handicaps (5f, soft/good) in June but she didn't really fire at Ascot (sixth of nine) two weeks ago; now drops back in grade but overall record is 1-15 and others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win was in a novice last May but she's on a reduced mark and has been placed at Bath (5.6f, good to firm) and Ffos Las (5f, good to soft) in her two runs this season; should go well again after a short break and she's still unexposed on AW.

RaceName: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden for two different yards and he was well below form at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; dropped another 3lb but he's been up and down so far and others are more convincing; stablemate of Guernsey Lady.

RaceName: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
Spotlight: Returned after a gelding operation with a win at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in March but he's been generally disappointing since; now 11lb lower than for his win but he struggled at Doncaster last time and is untried on Polytrack; down the list.

RaceName: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing D Turner B Roberts
Spotlight: Won handicaps at Chelmsford (6f, AW) and Yarmouth (5f, good) in the spring but he's gone off the boil recently and was only eighth of 12 at Newcastle last week; has a bit to prove and he's still 3lb higher than for his last success.

RaceName: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark with an emphatic win on turf here (5f, good to firm) last month and she defied a penalty when making all at Thirsk nine days later; that was a narrow success last time but a 3lb rise looks fair enough and she's a big player again back on AW.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner, going up 11lb for a convincing success in a 1m4f handicap at Tramore last month; may have gone as far as he can on the Flat off his new mark and a good time to go back hurdling; claims on his third in a Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; one of two runners for the stable.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Four-time Flat winner; useful maiden hurdle form including when a staying third in a 2m maiden hurdle at Galway last week; this trip should suit and he probably does not have to improve to land this.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper winner last summer; mostly quite ordinary Flat form since; ran well for much of the way in a Cork maiden hurdle on Monday; more needed here; one of two runners for the stable.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: First foal; dam unplaced bumper/2m-2m7f hurdles, half-sister to useful winners Victor Hewgo (2m4f-3m hurdle/chase), Crowning Jewel (2m3f-2m6f hurdle) and Sultans Pride (2m7f-3m2f hurdle); bred for stamina and best watched on his somewhat belated debut.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Finally won a point-to-point in April at the 12th time of asking; stable in good form but this one is best watched.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Chased home a clear winner in 2m5f Roscommon maiden a year ago and best effort since in similar contest early this month, tracking leaders and every chance when falling two out; definite player.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: No impression on his hurdles debut over C&D last month; should improve for that but an unlikely player here.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan
Spotlight: French improve; off for nine months before finishing second in a maiden hurdle at Cork last month; has more to find but every chance that there is more improvement to come; tongue-tie applied here.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: First foal; by a useful sire; dam soundly beaten in 2m hurdles, out of 2m-2m4f hurdle winner; likely one to watch this time.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in twop starts for Gordon Elliott last year; best watched on his stable debut.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Third foal; dam maiden Flat/hurdles, out of Italian Listed-placed 1m-1m2f winner; another debutante that is best watched.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Was weakening when fell two out on sole point start; tongue-tie on for rules debut; best watched.

RaceName: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Failed to complete in either point-to-point; jumped poorly on her hurdles debut at Ballinrobe; others preferred.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Continued his progress when drawing clear at Chester (10.5f, good) last Sunday; this is more competitive under a 5lb penalty but Ryan Kavanagh claims 3lb and this one has an obvious chance of following up.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Did well to finish third after stumbling at the start at Carlisle (1m1f, good) last month and has since run well over hurdles; no issue with track, trip or ground conditions and has possibilities for a trainer who has won this three times since 2021.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: 1-12; fair third over 1m1f at Hamilton three starts back but lesser efforts at York (1m6f and 1m) since; still 3lb above his winning mark and best form is at up to 1m1f; others more appealing.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent since winning by a nose over 1m (good to firm; off 5lb lower) in May but lacked the pace to figure when third to a progressive winner over C&D 12 days ago; others appear better handicapped.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner in 2024; run down late in refitted cheekpieces at Pontefract (1m2f) in June, and finished third (one place behind Mr Lincoln) over C&D next time; fast ground a plausible excuse for a lesser effort latest; runner-up in this last year.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: 0-10; runner-up in two of his last three races, failing to get a clear run when a close second at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) two months ago; on a positive trajectory but with more required from 4lb higher.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Hung left but took form to a new level when off the mark at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) in June; patience has been needed in pursuit of similar ground but considered from 5lb higher; trainer won this last year.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a career best when winning in added cheekpieces at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) six weeks ago; that form perhaps isn't the strongest on offer but he's open to further improvement off a 2lb higher mark.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Game win at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in June, in first-time cheekpieces; not in the same form since though and stamina not conclusive over 1m2f; better candidates to be found elsewhere.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice for David O'Meara on Newcastle AW (1m2f) in 2024 but 0-12 on turf; out of sorts last year, and has failed to beat a rival in last two appearances, at Newcastle and Redcar; mark is in freefall but plenty to prove.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
OwnerName: J D Wright & Mrs S Wright
Spotlight: Left Harry Charlton for 18,000gns; made a striking winning stable debut over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; hit with a 10lb rise but that form has been boosted twice since; massively respected.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs K Oliver And Miss K Scott
Spotlight: Modicum of promise in 1m4f maiden at Fairyhouse last month; left Willie McCreery for 8,000gns and makes handicap debut in change of headgear (blinkers) for new yard; worth a market check.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner (8.5f) for David Loughnane; creditable third to Unchartedterritory at Carlisle (1m1f; blinkers replaced cheekpieces) in June but he found little at Hamilton (1m3f) subsequently; stablemate Mr Lincoln looks to have a better chance.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) this year, the latest when narrowly beating a subsequent winner last month; only fifth of eight at Kempton on Wednesday but that was at 2m in a Class 5 and he's not ruled out on this drop back in trip/grade.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in three qualifying runs (1m2f) but she made a promising start in handicaps when runner-up at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) last month; up 3lb but she was long way clear of the third last time and is open to more progress at staying trips; respected.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
OwnerName: G E Bassett & P R Chamings
Spotlight: Sole win was in a heavy-ground handicap at Windsor (11.4f) in October 2024; ran well when third at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) in June but he struggled here (2m) last time and that took his AW record to 0-10; others preferred.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
Spotlight: Big improvement upped to 1m4f on handicap debut when beating an odds-on rival by 5l at Catterick (good to firm) on Tuesday; looks well treated under a penalty for that win and she shaped as though this step up to 1m6f should suit; strong contender.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
Spotlight: Well-bred gelding but he's beaten 7l, 9l and 14l in three runs (1m2f/1m) for two different yards this summer; still early days but he needs a transformation now upped to 1m6f on handicap debut.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he's finished runner-up in three of his five runs this season and wasn't beaten far when fourth of five at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) last time; looks worth a try at this new trip and he's in the mix back on AW.

RaceName: Bay Gardens Handicap
Spotlight: Made it 2-3 in handicaps when scoring at Kempton (1m4f, Polytrack) in March but she's been disappointing in both subsequent runs; still has low mileage but she needs a major revival at this new trip.

RaceName: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle
Spotlight: Seven-time winner over hurdles and fences; won a Listed handicap chase over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been all downhill since over a variety of trips; first run over hurdles since October.

RaceName: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle
Spotlight: Winning hurdler-chaser for Willie Mullins; good fifth in the Kim Muir on his stable debut in March; well beaten in the Midlands National here last month on his latest start; has a similar mark over hurdles and a very interesting runner at his best.

RaceName: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle
Spotlight: Enjoyed a fine hurdles campaign in 24-25, winning a Grade 3 at Gowran and finishing fourth in the Stayers' Hurdle at Cheltenham; winning debut over fences at Galway last September before things went a little pear-shaped; reverts back to hurdles here and at his best he would be very hard to oppose; whether he can produce his best is not so certain.

RaceName: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed ability in a 2m bumper here in June before a poor effort at Downpatrick; totally different test here on his hurdles debut and very hard to see him playing a part.

RaceName: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle
Spotlight: Stands out here as an improving mare; followed up a Sligo bumper success by easily landing a staying mares maiden hurdle at Killarney next month; much deeper waters here but no surprise should she be able to acquit herself well.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on his best form and some of that has been here, although not on his latest visit in July when only eighth; however, he's one of a few in here who would appreciate softening ground and firmly enters the reckoning.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: On a perfectly good mark, he won't mind rain and he ran surprisingly well to be fifth in last week's Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood; lots to like.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Successful in France and Ireland; impossible to make a case on his five runs for Ian Williams but he'll probably come good again at some point and any rain wouldn't harm his cause.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
OwnerName: Rise One Racing And W A Bethell
Spotlight: Ran moderately on most recent outing 50 days ago but mostly consistent for current yard and any rain would be much welcomed.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Gave it a good go from the front at Southwell (7f; fine at 1m) recently but he's been found wanting a few times since his last win, off 7lb lower on the AW last August; rain is forecast and he's unraced on ground slower than good.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June, after which he changed hands for 19,000gns; rain would be a bonus but he did trail home last at Hamilton only last week (1m5f) and has a good bit to prove at 1m.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on well for a seventh career success over C&D 19 days ago but he's gone back up 5lb and has never won anything better than a Class 5; others preferred.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been at 7f but he hasn't had many chances at this trip, over which he ran third on his penultimate start at Carlisle; had a break since a bad run in June and has possibilities.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Did well to come from so far back and win at Carlisle (1m, good) last month and the race wasn't run to suit at Hamilton since; this could be a better fit for her and she's back in good form.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Likeably consistent dual winner who won't mind what the weather does, with recent seconds at about 1m coming on soft and good to firm; pretty solid, other than this is a step up in class.

RaceName: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Without Parole filly who has been beaten 10l in two turf runs (6f) this summer but she's out of a well-related AW winner and is a possible improver on this step up to 1m; one to keep an eye on.

RaceName: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; 18-1 at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month and she was always in rear after a slow start; should know more this time but she needs to leave her initial form well behind.

RaceName: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 36,000gns yearling; Ghaiyyath filly out of 1m-1m2f winner (including Listed; RPR 100); attracted some support into 9-1 at Ayr (7f, good to firm) last month and she travelled well for a long way before finishing runner-up behind an experienced rival; that was a promising start and she's the standout contender on that form.

RaceName: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to three winners including White Chapel Road (7f 2yo; RPR 82) and Climate Precedent (2m hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to useful 6f 2yo winner Alamode, family of Champion Stakes winner Alborada and Arc winner Alpinista; interesting newcomer and she needs a close look.

RaceName: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Lucky Vega filly; second foal; dam unraced sister to 1m4f Listed winner Voodoo Queen, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Tinker Toy, out of 7f 2yo Group 1 winner; yard is in good form and she needs watching in market on debut.

RaceName: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Mohamed Rashid Hamdan Al Saadi & Partner
Spotlight: Always in rear and was beaten 14l when seventh of nine on Wolverhampton debut (7f, Tapeta) last month; others preferred.

RaceName: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Winning pointer and hunter chaser; well beaten on his only completed start this year in a 2m6f handicap chase at Galway last week.

RaceName: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Improving horse; followed a second in a Downpatrick beginners chase in June to easily make all in a 3m handicap chase at Wexford two weeks ago; up 10lb for that but there should be a lot more to come from him and he can follow up.

RaceName: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle here in April and produced his best effort to date over fences when a staying third in a 2m6f handicap chase at Galway last week (Kings Jet well behind); stays well and should go well.

RaceName: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Was a comfortable winner over fences at Limerick and hurdles at Tramore on last two starts in May; is now 12lb higher in this sphere but has to be feared if coming here in similar form.

RaceName: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Might have appreciated the three month break when returning to some sort of form in a 3m1f handicap hurdle here last month; could run well but others look that bit more likely.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: All turf runs on good or quicker ground; has had a busy year with some mixed results but he's taken a healthy drop in the weights and nearly nicked a Carlisle race in July; returned to that level when imposing himself on a C&D race 12 days ago and, back up 4lb, should have a big say.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Best form of the year when persevering well to win at Thirsk (6f, good) in June but disappointingly failed to do herself justice at Hamilton next time, a track where she won and went close (in a higher grade than this) last autumn; has had a short break since and may well revive.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Eight wins, all on good to soft or slower, include one over C&D; ran a cracker when fourth of 17 on Doncaster reappearance in March but he's kept his distance since, even when ground conditions looked suitable, but the more rain the better.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Winless since 7f success here in May 2024 and has yet to find his true form this year (beaten favourite three times; behind Mr Cool here last time) but he ran well on occasions in better 6f races than this in 2025 and won't mind what the weather does; quite well treated now and a revival could be imminent.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins between July and October last year, at 6f and 5f, including this race (good); runner-up four times this year and her latest Hamilton run can be consigned to history as she'd run the day before; respected, although serious rain wouldn't be ideal.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 0-8; involved in some hard-fought finishes over 6f on AW but he probably needs a bit more than a close fifth of five in his first turf handicap, at Catterick in May; ran better than the bare result back on AW last week but still needs to show he's as effective on grass, especially with rain about.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Ought to be open to some improvement at this level but he again failed to conserve his energy on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) in July and his challenge was very short-lived; reservations.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Not yet off the mark and was vulnerable in her early handicaps but she made a good fist of it when third on the wing over C&D (good to firm) in July; not so good here since but that was her third run in two weeks and will perhaps be all the better for more of a break this time.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Minor promise when qualifying but she was 22-1 when beaten a long way on her handicap/AW debut at Newcastle (7f) in June; too far behind there to consider seriously back on turf but at least the return to 6f should suit.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Close up in 7f events as a 3yo but she hasn't been her old self at 7f and 6f this year, in different headgear in two of her last three starts (none today); looks unlikely for now.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark in 6f handicap at Cork (yielding) last September; has been placed in big-field handicaps at 6f and 7f for this yard in 2026 and although below best when last seen in June she shouldn't be out of this, especially if the ground deteriorates.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Suited by Hamilton and was winning for the second time there two starts ago (both 6f; good to soft and good to firm); found little returned to 5f on this track since and the yard's other two runners look more likely.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Signed off 2yo season with 6f win on Newcastle AW; thereabouts in all three 6f races this year and there's little between her and Mr Cool on recent C&D form; however, she was struggling to keep up from some way out before coming home strongly and this test may again be on the sharp side.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden and novice winner who is yet to win a handicap but he finished a creditable third at Newbury (7f) last month and ran to a similar level when runner-up here (7.6f, good to firm) last time; should go well again off the same mark and he's still unexposed on AW.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins have been on Polytrack and latest was over C&D in April; only 2lb higher than for that success but he's been well held in both subsequent runs (AW/turf) and needs to rediscover his spark.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: Two turf wins (5.5f/5f) for David O'Meara last summer but he's 0-7 for current yard and was out the back at Wolverhampton (6f) last time; continues to drop down the weights but he has plenty to prove back up in trip; headgear removed.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: Ended a long losing run at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in April and he's held his form back on turf since, including a close call at Salisbury (6f, soft) and a 2l sixth in a big field at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month; still looks on a workable mark and he could be a big factor back on AW.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Beverley (7.4f, good) in June and he ran another good race when a clear second there last time; this return to Polytrack is no problem and he should give it another good shot with cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been at 1m including three on Polytrack; well treated on old form and he's run respectably in last two starts but his last win was over two years ago and others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Hewanorra Handicap
Spotlight: Eight AW wins and latest was over C&D in April; creditable run at Kempton (1m) last time and he's only 2lb higher than for that last success; not ruled out on this drop back in trip.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Consistent handicap chaser who had some good runs in top handicaps last season, such as fifth in the Grand Annual and fourth in Red Rum; returned from 99 days off with fifth at Killarney 22 days ago, weakening after being tight for room in the straight; should prove sharper for that and player if so; question whether step up in trip will suit but won his beginners chase over this distance two years ago.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Good debut over fences in May, third to two subsequent winners at Limerick; off the mark at second time of asking with Punchestown success in June, beating Jolie Jewel by 0.75l; struggled on handicap chase debut last time, however, and needs to bounce back.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Useful five-time winner for Peter Fahey; changed hands for E25,000 in November but unseated at the first on stable debut at Galway eight days ago; tongue-tie and cheekpieces left off now; enjoys nice ground and definite claims.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner, 1-5 over fences with sole win coming at Galway a year ago; been struggling since; showed up reasonably well before fading markedly at Galway eight days ago so this step back in trip could suit; needs more, though.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win came in heavy ground handicap hurdle last year; consistent in seven chase starts; arguably career best when beaten 11l into third by Vicar Street at Galway eight days ago; drop back in trip fine and he's going the right way; good claims.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: No win over fences since 2023 but is in good heart; beaten a neck at Kilbeggan (20.5, good) last month and beaten 15l into fifth in Galway Blazers eight days ago, may have made a better go of it but for being caught in a pocket between the final two fences; his third start in just over two weeks but chance if he doesn't feel the effects of that.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Five-time winner, 2-10 over fences; ran to form when last seen in this sphere in November, beaten 5l into third at Down Royal (3m, good); returned from lay-off with satisfactory run over hurdles 85 days ago; versatile trip-wise and enjoys good ground; could be in the mix.

RaceName: KEPAK Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Six-time winner, 4-38 over fences; chase mark has tumbled but good third at Ballinrobe (2m4f, good) in veterans race in May and decent run over hurdles at Sligo over inadequate trip; brought down at first at Kilbeggan last time; yard won this last two years.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Three of four wins have been at 7f, including over C&D (good) last August; back on his latest winning mark after failing to find his form this year and has plenty to prove following a 14l defeat at Doncaster in June.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Handles all surfaces; many good runs on turf over the last year, making all in first-time blinkers here (1m, good to firm) in July and two solid efforts since; headgear left off now tackling 7f for the first time since 2yo days in Ireland but has another good run in him.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in 7f AW maiden at Dundalk as 3yo; slightly frustrating for this yard as he's been involved in some tight finishes for them, including in this race last year and when just behind Supreme Clarets at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) in July, but fitting blinkers could help; solid chance, if so.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 7f winner on Newcastle AW in March; back on turf for the first time since last October but he's 8lb lower today and he does act on grass; however, jockey bookings suggest Highfield Viking is the stable preferred.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Took a step forward when winning 6f novice on Newcastle AW last December but she's had two crushing defeats in handicaps this year for new yard; can only watch.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: First British win when making all at Hamilton (about 1m, good to firm) in May; has remained in form there since without looking ahead of his mark but this first attempt at 7f looks worth investigating for last year's winning trainer.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs R G Hillen And Partner
Spotlight: Nearly made a successful switch to handicaps at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last September, just held by one who won three of his next five starts; had a quiet start to 2026 but did better when prominently ridden and having a little in hand against Milford Grange over C&D (soft) in June; up 3lb; capable of better.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Often leads; narrow Chester winner (7f, good to firm) last August on handicap debut and he ran much better back there in June than he had the time before at York; another bold show is on the cards.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden; one of his best efforts came over C&D (good to soft) last summer and yard has won two of the last five runnings but this one needs to improve on his handicap form so far, most recently when bleeding from the nose in June; now hooded.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Capable of better than he's shown on his last two starts at York, unsuccessfully tried over 1m then visored (left off today) in a higher grade; has possibilities on his close second to Circle Of Trust over C&D (soft) in June, albeit the latter pulled out extra when challenged; not ruled out.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Has led but not dependent on tactics; slowly away and never threatened at Chester latest but a first win shouldn't be far away on earlier narrow defeats, at Musselburgh and Carlisle (both 7f; good and good to firm), closely matched with Black Storm on the latter occasion; thereabouts.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Talented and well treated; multiple wins include two over C&D; nearly all his wins under Paul Mulrennan, who prefers Sanafi Zabeel, but he's also gone well for Lauren Young and ran creditably for her at Hamilton last week; the likely strong pace will suit and he's capable of a big run.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won 1m2f Bath novice as 2yo but just middling form from the front here of late, over 1m2f, 7f and 6f; dropping down the weights but this is competitive and the other two from the yard look more interesting.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Both wins have been in sprint handicaps at Wolverhampton and latest was after wind surgery last week; hit a personal best with that comfortable success and he is a big player again despite conceding weight all round back in a classified event.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won a classified event at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) in March but he's not come close to that form in four subsequent runs; visor is now tried and he needs a major revival back on Polytrack.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Dual Polytrack winner but she has an overall strike-rate of 3-38 and has been beaten 5l or more in her last five runs; has a change of headgear but she needs to raise her game back in trip.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Improved form when landing a classified event at Chelmsford (6f, AW) in February but he's not finished closer than seventh in four subsequent runs; overall record is now 1-13 and others are more convincing.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Sole win was in December 2024 but that was over C&D; finished down the field in three runs for current yard but the saddle slipped at Brighton (7f, good) last time and he was only beaten around 2l; could go well on this drop back in trip and he's not ruled out.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Has the same strike-rate (1-22) as Horus and his win was in November 2024; has been up and down this year but he was runner-up twice on AW (7f) in March and he didn't get the best of runs when a respectable sixth at Windsor (5f) last time; has another switch of headgear and he could be dangerous back up in trip.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
OwnerName: M Robinson, S Holden & T Helliwell
Spotlight: Six-race maiden who has generally struggled so far and was last of six in a Leicester handicap (5f, good to firm) last time; still early days but she needs a transformation back up in trip; visor reapplied.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Hard to predict and was well held at Salisbury last time but he looks interesting on his third in a Newbury handicap (6f, good to firm) in June; has claims if he can recapture that form and his last win was at this track.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Ex-Irish 3yo who is 0-8 and has not finished closer than 9l to a winner; has plenty to prove for new yard and she's untried at sprint trips; cheekpieces removed.

RaceName: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo but she's been tailed off at increasingly big prices in her three runs (7f/1m) since December; now switches to a classified event but she needs lots of improvement on this drop to 6f.

RaceName: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Jet Away gelding; brother to useful 2m3f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Reallyntruthfully, half-brother to 2m4f/3m hurdle winner Gold Smoke; dam bumper winner, half-sister to useful 2m-3m4f hurdle/chase winner Galaxy Rock; beaten 2.25l in point-to-point in May; could figure on rules debut.

RaceName: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Homebred by Rajj; beaten 31l into seventh on debut at Ballinrobe 18 days ago; needs significant improvement to be in with a winning chance.

RaceName: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Keen when seventh on debut at Down Royal; built on that when staying on into fifth at Bellewstown 35 days ago; held by Mr Enigma on that form but open to improvement now he's learning to settle.

RaceName: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Green and unsuited by emphasis on speed when beaten 12l into fifth on debut at Killarney 23 days ago; looks okay form with winner going on to follow up at Galway; improvement likely and won't be far away.

RaceName: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Raced with exuberance when beaten 9l into third on debut at Bellewstown; should build on that, especially if learning to settle; progression likely and should definitely be in the mix.

RaceName: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 23,000euros 3yo; half-sister to bumper winner Appy Getaway; dam bumper/1m7f hurdle winner, sister to useful bumper, 1m4f/1m6f Flat and 2m hurdle/chase winner Royal Alphabet, out of 7f Group 3 winner; eye-catching pedigree; market vibes need to be monitored.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Well backed and returned to form when winning classified event at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last week; that was steadily run but he was an emphatic winner; every chance if able to reproduce equivalent level on turf (0-9); stablemate of Sassy Glory.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 1-25; keeping reasonable form over further until a low-key effort at Musselburgh (1m5f, good) last week; dropping back to 1m2f is helpful (was third in this last year) but others still make more appeal.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Veteran (5-81) stablemate of Zebra Star; respectable third over 1m here (good to firm) in July, but could make only minimal inroads over C&D (fifth; 22-1) latest; this is a slightly easier task.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 1-18, that win in a newly applied visor here (1m, good to soft; 16-1) last July; finished sixth behind Golden Valour on return from six-month break over C&D latest; could strip fitter.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Irish raider; ran far better than finishing position suggests (pecked badly at second-last) over hurdles at Kilbeggan (2m3f) a fortnight ago; cosy Flat winner at Limerick (1m4f, yielding) in April and needs respecting at this basement level.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
OwnerName: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club
Spotlight: Runner-up (beaten over 4l) in this last year, but yet to win on turf (0-17); gamely fended off the frustrating Little Ted at Newcastle (1m; 11-2) on penultimate start, but reportedly ran flat back there on latest; stable have more obvious chance with Wicklow Way.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden; fourth (not far behind Falaise Blanc) at Musselburgh (12.5f; 33-1) in June, but weakened over C&D (raced keenly) subsequently; level of competition suitable, but others are easier to recommend.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Dual course winner, the most recent over this trip (Class 6, good to soft) over a year ago; no obvious excuses (form figures 9549) in 2026, but does have a capable 5lb claimer aboard, and further rain could assist; stablemate of Golden Valour.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-5; better since joining this trainer, twice placed over 1m here (Class 6); run style wouldn't suggest he's the most obvious candidate for 1m2f, but pedigree does offer hope; still open to improvement; isn't discounted.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Failed to win for William Knight (0-7), beaten at odds-on at Yarmouth (1m2f classified) on final start for that trainer; visor (worn twice) has yielded some improvement; wise to monitor this 7,000gns purchase on stable debut.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 12-race maiden; placed over this trip at Beverley (beaten 3l) in June but disappointing since, beaten nearly 50l (last of seven) over 1m4f at Pontefract latest; focus elsewhere.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Yet to win (0-8) and not many positives to take from latest C&D effort; Mulrennan takes the ride aboard this stablemate of Storm On Jura; opposable.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Goes for a hat-trick today and has a nice pedigree (by Speightstown); ran out a ready winner over 6 1/2f at Churchill Downs (allowance optional claimer) 45 days ago; despite that Churchill Downs success, one to tread carefully with.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Ran a bit below expectations (sent off 11-10) when fifth in a black type (Churchill Downs) two months ago; could have a say if replicating the best of her form and she goes well fresh.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Randall L Bloch, Six Column Stables LLC Et Al
Spotlight: Had a couple of these behind when springing a 28-1 surprise four weeks ago in an allowance Grade 3; has won three of her five career starts.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Attempts to land a hat-trick and two from three in her career so far; won an allowance optional claimer by just over 5l at Churchill Downs in May; despite that Churchill Downs success, may have to settle for supporting role at best.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Just denied over 6 1/2f here (allowance Grade 3) behind Sippin Pretty last month; track has proven suitable before; has made an impressive start to her career with three wins from six starts; has to be respected.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Successful four times in her last seven starts; favourite and only narrowly beaten in an allowance listed (Churchill Downs) behind Explora two months ago; competitive shout.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Michael E Pegram, Karl Watson & Paul Weitman
Spotlight: Scored narrowly in an allowance listed (Churchill Downs) when back to this distance two months ago; has chalked up four wins from her last seven; the Bob Baffert operation is running hot currently; leading claims.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Legion Racing, MHM Stables LLC Et Al
Spotlight: Beaten 9l into fifth last month in an allowance Grade 3; has winning form at this track; successful twice in her last five starts; easy to oppose.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Gary Barber, Cheyenne Stable LLC & Wachtel Stable
Spotlight: High-class miler (fourth in latest Breeders' Cup Mile) and better than ever in 2026; improved form to win Grade 1 Turf Classic at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May by 3l from Make Me King, making all; upset in stalls, unable to dominate when around 1l fourth to Deterministic in Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) here afterwards; not seen to best advantage last time and rates as the one to beat.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Smart form on last two starts here, winning black type event in June (8.5f; easily by 4l) then dead-heating with Zulu Kingdom in Grade 3 Kelso (1m); progressive, but does need to improve again to threaten the best here.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Madaket Stables LLC, Michael Dubb Et Al
Spotlight: Clearly best effort to win Grade 1 Maker's Mark Mile at Keeneland in April by around 1l from One Stripe, dictating steady pace before kicked into clear lead and holding on; creditable efforts on balance of smart form since, dead-heating with Mi Bago (same terms) in Grade 3 Kelso over C&D; faces pressure for lead and opposed on balance.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Gary Barber, Blue Crevalle Racing & Eclipse T'Bred Partners
Spotlight: Improving filly who won Grade 2 Churchill Downs Distaff Turf Mile (by neck from Portfolio Duration, idling in front) and Grade 1 Just A Game Stakes here (1m), on latter occasion impressively by over a length from Mandanaba, making all and lengthening powerfully in straight, never looking likely to be caught; will take a good male to concede weight to her in same form.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: St Elias Stable, Ken Langone Et Al
Spotlight: In the form of his life at present, continuing his winning spree when beating Test Score by half a length in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes here (9.5f) last time, pressing leader and battling on with great tenacity in the straight; has now won three Grade 1s (including this race in 2025) and looks sure to make a concerted defence of his title.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has plenty to prove to better this type of rival on all known form, including 3l fourth of ten to dead-heaters Zulu Kingdom and Mi Bago in Grade 3 Kelso over course and distance latest; opposed.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: HRH Prince Sultan Bin Mishal Al Saud
Spotlight: Has racked up ten wins from 28 starts under shrewd placement from Steve Asmussen; completed five-timer in 2026 with Grade 3 Arlington and Grade 2 Wise Dan Stakes wins, both over 8.5f at Churchill Downs; has only tried Grade 1 company once, when only seventh in this last year; maybe in a shade too deep.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: West Paces Racing/Rainbow's End Racing/Michael P Lyden
Spotlight: Useful form when in frame over 8.5f here in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge Stakes (under 2l fourth to West End Kid) and Listed Saranac Stakes (under 1l third to Heeere's Johnny); pitched in deep here and will need a perfect game to reach a place.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Magic Carpet Racing, Catherine W Coyle & Blue Bison Stable
Spotlight: Under 6l fifth to Gstaad in Grade 1 Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf at Del Mar (1m) last November; 15-1, roughly same level of form when winning Listed race over 8.5f here (8.5f) by neck from Blinging It Back; should be suited by today's longer trip but needs a lot more to contend in this grade.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unbeaten in first three, including Grade 3 Transylvania at Keeneland in April; placed in Grade 1 American Turf at Churchill Downs (8.5f; second to Stark Contrast) and Belmont Derby here (1m1f; close third to Title Role); must go well again.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has thrived in 2026, winning Listed race at Meydan (1m) in February, Group 2 German 2,000 Guineas at Cologne (1m) in May and Grade 1 Belmont Derby here (1m1f; beat West End Kid and Remember Mamba in close finish, better placed turning in than either); slightly longer trip does not favour him.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Very useful form when third over 1m2f this season in Group 3 Hampton Court Stakes at Royal Ascot (about 1l behind Generic) and in Listed Gala Stakes at Sandown (beaten 2l by Sallaal), accelerating well from rear both times but no extra close home; fits in terms of class and first-time cheekpieces could really help.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Reeves Thoroughbred Racing, Tony Weintraub & Brandon Dalinka
Spotlight: Looked a bright prospect on Tapeta as a juvenile, winning maiden at Presque Isle Downs (1m) and Grade 3 Grey Stakes at Woodbine (8.5f; beat smart Silent Tactic by under 1l); huge task on turf debut and on first start for nine months; blinkers retained.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won two of his first four starts on turf, include allowance race at Keeneland in April over this trip (beat Noble Dynasty by a neck); improved effort on dirt debut at Delaware (sloppy going; scored by two and a half lengths) last time; should be just as effective back on grass but lots to find.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Looked smart prospect when winning first two starts last year, notably Grade 2 Pilgrim Stakes at Aqueduct in October; not disgraced here in 2026, third to West End Kid in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge and fifth to Title Role in Grade 1 Belmont Derby (1m1f), in latter poorly placed; place claims.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Progressive form in five starts, scoring in maiden at Keeneland in April, allowance at Churchill Downs in May and Grade 3 Pennine Ridge here (8.5f) in June; shaped like best horse, set plenty to do and finishing best, when eye-catching close second to Title Role again here (1m1f) in Grade 1 Belmont Derby; outside draw makes things difficult.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Has improved into top-class colt as 4yo, winning Grade 3 Razorback Handicap at Oaklawn (8.5f; by 4l) in February, Grade 1 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f) in March and Grade 1 Stephen Foster Stakes at Churchill Downs in June (1m1f; broke out of stalls beforehand, again made all and beat Baeza by a length and a quarter); owns deep stamina and courage and deserves to be regarded as the division's leading male performer.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Top-class filly, surely the best of her sex around two turns on dirt; deeply impressive in 13l win over Bless The Broken in Grade 1 Ogden Phipps over C&D on latest start, still going strongly with field in trouble turning in, changing gears and soon a long way clear (outstanding time); much stiffer task against males but coming off a performance of rare standing.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Career-best effort last August in trouble-affected Grade 1 Jockey Club Gold Cup here (1m2f); well below that form in three of four starts since, except when winning Grade 3 Westchester Stakes at Aqueduct (1m) by 6l from Bishops Bay; very smart on his day but finds this type of rival tough.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C2 Racing Stable, Mathis Stable LLC & TCC Stables LLC
Spotlight: Hard-charging front runner; got loose early in Grade 2 at Santa Anita in May (1m2f) and proceeded to register very smart effort in beating Malarchuk by 10l; nowhere near that level in the face of even mild pressure up front and will not find this group accommodating.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Gary Barber & La Milagrosa Stable LLC
Spotlight: High-class form at best, winning four Grade 1s including 2023 Breeders' Cup Classic at Santa Anita and 2025 Pegasus World Cup (1m1f) at Gulfstream Park; returned to form when winning Grade 2 Oaklawn Handicap in April (by 2l from Sovereignty) but moderate fourth of five behind Magnitude last time; difficult to predict.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: US Horse of the Year in 2025; won Kentucky Derby at Churchill Downs and three times at Saratoga afterwards, notably Grade 1 Belmont Stakes and Grade 1 Travers (by 10l); well below best this season, second to White Abarrio in Grade 2 at Oaklawn on reappearance, then really disappointing third to Magnitude in Grade 1 Stephen Foster at Churchill Downs, weakening tamely stretch; brilliant at best and goes really well here but optimism for return to form rests on news of encouraging workouts, rather than anything seen on track.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Winchell Thoroughbreds LLC, Derrick Smith Et Al
Spotlight: Nowhere near this class yet; won allowance race at Churchill Downs in May before moderate third to Phileas Fogg in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes here (1m2f) last month.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C R K Stable LLC & Grandview Equine
Spotlight: Smart horse on his day who beat Magnitude by just over 2l in Grade 1 Pennsylvania Derby (1m1f) last September; creditable efforts this year, around 1l second to same rival in Grade 1 Stephen Foster at Churchill Downs last time, running on; not far behind these on balance and could take a hand if the early pace is too strong.
